meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.libelle: croissance organique totale du chiffre d'affaires du premier trimestre 2027
guidances.citation: •Total organic revenue growth is expected to range approximately between 3%-4% relative to the first quarter of fiscal 2026.

guidances.libelle: marge d'EBITDA ajusté du premier trimestre 2027
guidances.citation: •Adjusted EBITDA margin is expected to expand by approximately 100 to 150 basis points relative to the first quarter of fiscal 2026.

guidances.libelle: chiffre d'affaires total publié de l'exercice 2027
guidances.citation: The Company expects total reported revenue from continuing operations to range approximately between $648 to $660 million for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.

guidances.libelle: croissance organique totale du chiffre d'affaires de l'exercice 2027
guidances.citation: •Total organic revenue growth is expected to range approximately between up 3% to 5% relative to fiscal 2026.

guidances.libelle: expansion de la marge d'EBITDA ajusté de l'exercice 2027
guidances.citation: •Adjusted EBITDA margin expansion of 200 to 250 basis points year-over-year, inclusive of the expected dilution of 100 basis points associated with the Elegen agreements and SynPlexity acquisition.

guidances.libelle: flux de trésorerie disponible de l'exercice 2027
guidances.citation: •Free cash flow (cash flow from operations less capital expenditures) is expected to improve approximately 25%, relative to fiscal 2026.

communiques.raison: en file d'attente (plafond de communiqués par exécution)
